notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: 19.03.08
notes.notes:
-Added 4 new teams. They can be modified by changing the files in the Action Card Football\Action Card Football_Data\StreamingAssets\teams directory. Changes will transfer in multiplayer games.  (Check out the ReadMe.txt file in the SteamingAssets directory for the format of definitions in the team.csv file)

-New user created teams can be added by adding a new "5", "6", "7", etc directory and following the templates of the 4 new teams & adding files to the Action Card Football\Action Card Football_Data\StreamingAssets\teams directory. Can also change the uniform if you add it to Action Card Football\Action Card Football_Data\StreamingAssets\uniforms. User made uniforms will transfer in multiplayer games as long as the file size is keep below 26k.

-fixed a couple stats that were calculated wrong

-Added a big "Return to Main Menu" button on the game over screen.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: A Chinese New Year
notes.notes:
Strange things are afoot in steamgamesland. A powerful new force has begun to show its face on Western shores. Hailing from the tiny island nation of China, a wave of intrepid indie developers are shaking off a variety of undeserved reputations and delivering a solid fifth* of the shortlist of games we consider for Unknown Pleasures, the roundup of the best new games too few people are playing.

But did any of them make the final cut? Is this the beginning of a bright new era following Steam’s recent controversies? And are any of them bloody roguelikes?

Adhering to the rule of three this week: non-dwarven fortresses, kindhearted fireflies, and China, China, CHINA. (more…)

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: BETA19.01.10
notes.notes:
-Added "away" team jerseys.

-Fixed up card text so that lines are no longer hidden. 

-New card upgrade system. You have to earn card upgrades by winning stats...look for the stats with the stars to earn them.

-Fixed bugs that could allow two multiplayer games to get out of sync with each other.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.12.18
notes.notes:
-added steam achievements

-Added "AI Mode" - activate with "a" and AI will take over your play calling. 

-fixed card "Shed Block" sticking around unless there is a opponent card to nullify.

-fixed card "1st down machine" to fire off if you get a 1st down with it up. 

-fixed resume from saved game not initializing trigger card graphics right in all cases

-fixed defensive "add STAT" to yards. 

-Fixed interception/fumble bars from not moving to the right location in response to cards. 

-Made the smartest AI level less predictable.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.12.01b
notes.notes:
-Fixed client camera not being reset on FG failures. Added play clock option of 80 seconds (as well as default 40 seconds & off) and multiplayer propagation.

-1st stab at season mode. 6 games season progression, between games 4 players will come to you with a problem that you have to try to solve with one of three resources (nurture, discipline, or money). Solving their problems gains your team stat bonuses.

-Roster page upgrade card working, so you can experiment with different cards & upgrades and see how they affect plays.

-Fixed multiplayer onside kick (all kicks really) not working right

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.10.26d
notes.notes:
-Added roster page functionality so that you can see how the player roster cards will interact with the various plays in the team's playbook.

-Difficulty slider & play clock timer activation options now saved. 

-Added a save/resume game on exit/enter single player with UI elements & choice to continue saved game or start new game.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.10.17f
notes.notes:
-Added roster page so that user can customize the teams, changing trigger cards for each football player. 

-Roster changes propagate in multiplayer games

-Now saving config data in a directory based on Steam User ID, so that games shared on the same computer by multiple accounts each have their own data.

 -Fixed Steam stats, win/loss.tie stats not updating

-Added Difficulty slider to adjust AI intelligence

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES ALPHA18.10.08

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.09.25c

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES: ALPHA18.09.13
